title: Weighted warmup-probe fallback with telemetry hooks for pinned versions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: When a customer pins to an exact model version and that variant becomes degraded (region issues, CVE-initiated rollback, or incompatible quantization), current fallbacks either pick a single hard-coded substitute or run broad region-wide failovers. This can cause latency spikes, fidelity regressions, or customer surprise.

Goal: Implement a fallback mechanism for pinned model versions that uses lightweight warmup probes and a weighted scoring matrix to choose fallback variants and regions. The mechanism should be observable in Console, reversible, and safe by default (do not auto-promote experimental variants).

Scope: Design and implement server-side selection logic, probe orchestration, telemetry hooks to Console and the incidents dashboard, config flags for rollout behavior, and a migration path for existing pinned routes. This ticket covers runtime selection logic, API contract changes for pin metadata, and telemetry/alerting requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Fallback selection uses a weighted score combining regional health, latency tail estimates, fidelity delta (from model evaluator), and warmup-probe results
Warmup probes are non-customer-facing synthetic requests that exercise end-to-end path and are bounded by budget and rate limits
Telemetry events for every fallback decision are emitted with reason codes (PROBE_OK, PROBE_SLOW, HEALTH_DEGRADED, COMPATIBILITY_MISMATCH)
Console displays a per-route fallback history timeline and aggregate metrics (fallback rate, avg delta latency, QoE impact)
A canary rollout path exists: canary traffic to variant A triggers probes then scales to majority only after probe gating passes
Feature is behind a runtime flag and default behavior remains current hard fallback until rollout completes
Automated abort/rollback if 5-minute SLO breach correlated to new fallback > threshold
design_notes: Scoring: score = w1*(regional_health) + w2*(1/estimated_95th_latency) + w3*(1-fidelity_loss) + w4*(probe_score)
Regional health from existing NOC heartbeat + capacity signals; fidelity_loss from precomputed model evaluator docs published to model catalog
Probe type: small representative prompts drawn from route's pinned profile with deterministic seed; probes measure cold-start + steady-state latency and basic output checksum heuristics
Probe budget: per-route default 1-2 probes/minute with exponential backoff under stress; probes must never consume dedicated customer capacity on Dedicated clusters
Safety gates: block variants without a published performance profile unless explicitly allowed by customer (opt-in), enforce max allowed fidelity_loss configurable per route
Rollback token: each fallback decision emits a token that can be used by Console to force revert and by incident responders to correlate logs/metrics
Compatibility layer: add a "compatibility_score" to model metadata published during onboarding; runtime consults this to avoid unsafe substitutions
Integration: hooks to existing rollout controller to coordinate canary percentages and to the cache warmup subsystem to prefill KV caches when promoting a variant
rollout_steps: Dev: unit tests + local runtime flag; end-to-end in staging with synthetic tenants (2 weeks)
Canary: enable for 5% of pinned routes in us-west with detailed telemetry and QA runbooks (1 week)
Ramp: increase canary to 25% then 50% after 72h stable metrics; monitor SLOs and fallback-specific alerts
Enterprise preview: opt-in toggle for Dedicated/Private customers to trial the probe-based fallback (customer success engaged)
GA: enable by default for new onboardings; existing pins remain opt-in for 30 days before auto-enable with email notice
migration_notes: Existing pinned routes receive a new pin metadata field 'fallback_policy' set to 'legacy' until migration runs
Migration job will sample top-traffic pinned routes, run simulated probe runs offline, and produce a migration report per tenant
Customer-facing API: POST /pins/{id}/migration-preview returns expected fallback candidates and estimated fidelity/latency deltas
Docs: update onboarding guide to include compatibility_score and recommendations for acceptable fidelity thresholds
telemetry_and_alerting: Emit event type 'fallback.decision' with fields: route_id, pin_version, chosen_variant, reasons[], probe_result_id
Emit 'fallback.failure' when fallback attempt fails to route within timeout; escalate to oncall if rate > configured threshold
Dashboard tiles: fallback rate by route, mean delta latency post-fallback, 95th percentile latency per-variant over time
Alert: trigger if fallback rate > 0.5% of requests for more than 15 minutes and correlated SLO degradation
Log retention: fallback decision logs kept for 90 days and accessible via Console timeline
api_changes: Pin metadata extended: { 'pin_version': string, 'fallback_policy': enum('legacy','probe-weighted','manual'), 'compatibility_score_min': float }
New admin endpoint: POST /admin/fallback/probe-execute to trigger manual probes for a route with response payload summarizing probe metrics
New events into model catalog: 'compatibility_score' and 'published_perf_profile' must be present for probe-weighted policy
Console UI: new panel under Route Settings to configure fallback_policy and fidelity thresholds
security_considerations: Probes must avoid sending customer PII; probes use sanitized prompt templates and synthetic seeds
Admin probe endpoints are RBAC-protected and logged to audit events
No automatic promotion of unverified variants in Private deployments without tenant consent
